name: bubble
useFor: Use inside Message for each piece of a conversation with an agent or a contact. Use the default (purple) variant with align end for what the person or their agent sent, secondary (lilac) for what arrived, tinted for another agent over Agent2Agent, muted for a system note, outline for a quoted message and destructive for one that failed to send. Stack consecutive bubbles in a BubbleGroup so only the last keeps the tail. BubbleReactions pins reactions to an edge.
constraints: Bubbles in colors outside the palette
An entrance animation on each bubble
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): iMessage and the inbox, in the action purple and the lilac
